title: ProposalDeclined v1 - data
description: SUPERSEDED by PolicyIssuanceFailed with failureKind INSURER_DECLINED (DECISIONS-2026-10-22 E1: the underwriting decision precedes payment, so a post-payment decline is a non-issuance). Never emitted; kept so a consumer built against the D8 draft fails review rather than silently. Producer: policy. Status: SUPERSEDED. The `data` member of event-envelope/v1 (ADR-025): ids and states only, never customer PII.

applicationNumber.description: Insurer application number (insurer-issued reference, not customer data)
